data_availability.summary: Dubai Calendar exposes no public API: dubaicalendar.ae redirects into bot-protected visitdubai.com (Akamai returns 403 to non-browser clients), and the only official events dataset (slug dtcm_e_permits_events-open-api, now served from the apis.data.dubai gateway after the Dubai Pulse portal was decommissioned) requires OAuth credentials. This pack therefore stays curated.

venue_shift.summary: DWTC anchor shows are migrating to the expanded Dubai Exhibition Centre at Expo City Dubai. GITEX Global leads the move in December 2026, with Gulfood and WHX Dubai following in 2027.

edition_2026.verification_note: On 1 September 2026 the Dubai Government announced Dubai Future Week (18 to 21 November 2026), which brings the Dubai Future Forum and Dubai AI Week communities together in one connected platform. The earlier 6 to 9 April 2026 dates do not establish that a standalone 2026 edition was held, and no separate AI Week days within the November week are published.

events.name: Dubai Fitness Challenge 2026
events.notes: 10th edition. Dubai Ride (4 km family and 12 km routes) opens the challenge on Sheikh Zayed Road on 1 November 2026, Dubai Stand-Up Paddle runs at Hatta Dam on 7 and 8 November, Dubai Run (5 km and 10 km) takes over Sheikh Zayed Road on 22 November and Dubai Yoga (second edition) closes the programme on 29 November. Dates come from the 1 October 2026 Dubai Media Office release announcing registration; route distances come from press coverage because dubaifitnesschallenge.com blocks automated fetches. Free, pre-registration required.

events.name: Dubai Shopping Festival 2026-27
events.notes: 32nd edition, 4 December 2026 to 17 January 2027 (45 days), starting after the Eid Al Etihad holiday. The Visit Dubai DSF page shows these dates and the DFRE release (distributed via Zawya, press coverage dated 14 October 2026) confirms the edition and length. Returning features named in the release include etisalat DSF Nights, DSF x Hatta Wadi Hub, DSF Auto Season and etisalat MOTB in January; individual sub-event dates and the raffle schedule were not yet published as of 20 October 2026.

last_refresh_scope: Targeted refresh of 2026-10-20: Dubai Shopping Festival 2026-27 (32nd edition) dates are now announced as 4 December 2026 to 17 January 2027 (45 days), per the Visit Dubai DSF page and the DFRE release carried by Zawya (press coverage dated 14 October 2026), confirming the third-party claim flagged at the last review. Supernova 0X: the official page now gives the final application deadline as 1 November 2026 (recorded earlier as 2 November), no longer advertises the USD 200,000 equity-free cash prize pool (prize_pool_usd is now null and equity_free is dropped), lists in-kind prizes per stage, and requires applicants to be exhibiting startups. GITEX Global 2026: gitex.com puts the 7 December GITEX Summit at Dubai World Trade Centre and the 8 to 11 December expo at the Dubai Exhibition Centre, Expo City Dubai; venue, notes and schedule now say so. Dubai Fitness Challenge: Dubai Ride (1 November), Dubai Stand-Up Paddle at Hatta Dam (7 to 8 November), Dubai Run (22 November) and Dubai Yoga (29 November) are now sourced to the 1 October 2026 Dubai Media Office release. Dubai Home Festival: the Visit Dubai page now shows the 2026 window (16 October to 1 November). Checked with no change on organiser or official sites: Expand North Star (8 to 10 December, Expo City Dubai), Dubai AI Festival (26 to 27 October, DWTC), Dubai FinTech Summit (2 to 3 November, Madinat Jumeirah), Dubai Future Week (18 to 21 November; the Dubai Future Forum page still redirects to it), UN 2026 Water Conference (8 to 10 December, ADNEC), STEP Dubai 2027 (3 to 4 February, Dubai Internet City), AIM Congress 2027 (12 to 14 April, DWTC) and Dubai Airshow 2027 (15 to 19 November 2027; the show runs in odd years, so there is no 2026 edition). No event in the pack ended between 13 and 20 October 2026; WETEX (20 to 22 October) and the Dubai Home Festival are in progress, and WGES runs 21 to 22 October. Unverified: WETEX and WGES (wetex.ae and dewa.gov.ae return HTTP 403 to automated checks), WGS 2027 venue, Dubai Festival of Lights 2026 (no new source), DSF sub-event and raffle dates, and Dubai Run and Ride route distances (press only). Not a full re-verification of every field in this pack; full_review_date is preserved.
